'''Dimone Irrv''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as the local manager of [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]] on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. She reached her position through sheer managerial competence, and, if forced into it, was an expert at corporate maneuvering.
